# 247clerk

> 247clerk is a WhatsApp AI clerk that handles after-hours client intake for South African professional practices — attorneys, immigration practitioners, tax practitioners, conveyancers, financial advisers and estate agents. It screens the matter, answers process and fee questions, books the consultation, collects the consultation fee, and escalates anything requiring professional advice to the practitioner.

247clerk runs on a practice's existing WhatsApp business number. It is explicitly built not to give legal, tax or financial advice: it answers process, fee, document and availability questions, screens enquiries against criteria the practice defines, and hands anything touching the merits of a matter to an admitted practitioner. It will sign an operator agreement under POPIA (Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013) on request.

Key facts:
- Market: South Africa. Pricing in rand.
- Channel: WhatsApp (not voice).
- Plans: Front Desk R495/month (100 enquiries); Full Shift R1,195/month (300 enquiries); Chambers R2,495/month (800 enquiries). 14-day free trial on all three, capped at 25 enquiries.
- Metering: one enquiry is one client conversation, however many messages it takes. Overage is billed per enquiry, never throttled. Meta's per-message WhatsApp fees are included in the plan.
- Setup time: about 15 minutes. Nothing for clients to install.
- Integrations: Google Calendar, PayFast, Stripe.
- Contact: admin@247clerk.com

## For your practice
- [Attorneys and law firms](https://247clerk.com/for/attorneys): Matter screening, conflict-check material, paid first consultations.
- [Immigration attorneys](https://247clerk.com/for/immigration-attorneys): Visa type, refusal section and date, appeal windows, multilingual intake.
- [Conveyancers](https://247clerk.com/for/conveyancers): Transfer cost and timeline questions, signed-OTP confirmation, bond and bank details.
- [Tax practitioners and accountants](https://247clerk.com/for/tax-practitioners): Assessment dates, amounts in dispute, objection deadlines, routine return pricing.
- [Estate agents and agencies](https://247clerk.com/for/estate-agents): Budget, finance status, timeline, viewings booked into the agent's diary.
- [Financial and estate advisers](https://247clerk.com/for/financial-advisers): Asset ranges, mandate type, advice needs, discovery meetings.
